reasons.correctness: updateTicketStatus publishes SupportTicketResolvedEvent only for RESOLVED, after save. Port, adapter (subject contains reference) and listener match the interface. Build green, 5/5 acceptance, 55/55 existing tests.
reasons.convention_fit: Listener uses @TransactionalEventListener(AFTER_COMMIT) and catches and logs. Port is in support/ticket/port, adapter in adapter. The event publisher is added via the constructor and the existing test was updated. New MockitoExtension unit test added.
reasons.design_fit: The listener depends only on TicketNotificationPort; the email adapter is the only EmailService binding. The service just publishes an event. Footprint is minimal, follows the InvoiceCreatedEvent pattern, and adds no parallel mechanism.
reasons.test_quality: Covers publish-on-RESOLVED with field checks, no publish on other transitions, listener delegation, and a swallowed port failure. EmailTicketNotificationAdapter has no test. The failure test has no explicit assertDoesNotThrow or log check.
reasons.graph_use: Graph queries mapped the support package and existing Port/Adapter/EventListener files before any edit. The agent then read InvoiceCreatedEventListener, InvoicingPort and FakturowniaAdapter as exemplars and followed their structure.
